card.name: Low heart-rate cutoffs and anticoagulation
card.fires_on: The digit after a heart-rate threshold such as 'below 6' or 'less than 5' (bpm), and the end of 'anticoagulation' in warnings about stopping anticoagulants. It also fires weakly on a few other words, such as 'glucose' after '50%'.
